# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2005

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 01**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance enacting the Pre-Closing Special Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2004. At the close of business on December 31, 2004, there was a savings of P 5,584,543.56 and an overdraft in appropriation. The ordinance appropriates P 9,491,942.00 to cover up overdraft in appropriation to make expenditures proper and legal for the year 2004.

**Total savings at close of business (Dec 31, 2004):** P 5,584,543.56
**Amount appropriated to cover overdraft:** P 9,491,942.00

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** At the close of business on December 31, 2004, there is a savings of P 5,584,543.56 and an overdraft in appropriation.
- **Section 2.** The amount of P 9,491,942.00 is hereby appropriated to cover up overdraft in appropriation in the amount of P 9,491,942.00 to make it proper and legal the expenditures for the year 2004.
- **Section 3.** The Pre-Closing Special Budget prepared by the Municipal Budget Officer is hereby attached and made as an integral part of this ordinance marked as "Annex A".
